chapterInfo.content:
3
Sardi nwoma
1 # Adi 5.6; 1.16 Na Sardi asafo mu bɔfoɔ no, twerɛ kɔma no sɛ: Sɛɛ na deɛ ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn ahonhom nson ne nsoromma nson no seɛ: Menim wo nnwuma, sɛ wowɔ din sɛ wote aseɛ, nanso woawuo. 2#Adi 3.19; Hes 34.4 Nyane, na hyɛ nkaeɛ a ɛrebɛwuo no den. Na menhunuu wo nnwuma sɛ ɛyɛ pɛ me Nyankopɔn anim. 3Enti kae sɛdeɛ woanya na woateɛ na di so, na sakyera w’adwene! Na sɛ woanwɛn a, mɛba sɛ owifoɔ, na worenhunu dɔn ko a mɛba wo soɔ. 4#Yuda 23 Nanso wowɔ nnipa kakraa bi a wɔnguu wɔn ntadeɛ ho fi wɔ Sardi, na wɔne me bɛnante ntadeɛ fitaa mu, ɛfiri sɛ wɔfata. 5#Adi 4.4; 6.11; 7.9; 7.13; Flp 4.3; Mat 10.32 Deɛ ɔdi nkonim no na wɔbɛhyɛ no atadeɛ fitaa saa, na merempepa ne din mfiri nkwa nwoma no mu, na mɛbɔ ne din m’Agya ne n’abɔfoɔ anim. 6Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no reka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no.
Filadelfia nwoma
7 # Yes 22.22 Na Filadelfia asafo mu bɔfoɔ no, twerɛ kɔma no sɛ:
Sɛɛ na ɔkronkronni, ɔnokwafoɔ no,
deɛ ɔkura Dawid safoa,
na ɔhini a obi nto mu,
na ɔto mu, a obi nhini no, seɛ:
8 Menim wo nnwuma. Hwɛ, mede ɛpono a wɔahini masi w’anim a obi ntumi nto mu, ɛfiri sɛ wowɔ ahoɔden ketewa bi, na woadi m’asɛm so, na woampa me din. 9#Adi 2.9; Yes 60.14; 49.23 Hwɛ, mede ebinom a wɔfiri Satan hyiadan mu, a wɔka sɛ wɔyɛ Yudafoɔ, na wɔnyɛ, na mmom wɔdi atorɔ no mema. Hwɛ, mɛma wɔaba na wɔabɛkoto wo nan ase, na wɔahunu sɛ madɔ wo. 10#Adi 13.10; Heb 10.36 Ɛsiane sɛ woadi me boasetɔ asɛm soɔ nti, me nso mɛkora wo, sɔhwɛ berɛ a ɛbɛba wiase nyinaa soɔ, sɛ wɔbɛsɔ wɔn a wɔte asase soɔ ahwɛ no, mu. 11#Adi 1.3; 2.5; 2.10 Mereba ntɛm; sɔ deɛ wowɔ no mu, na obi annye w’abotire.
12 # Gal 2.9; Adi 14.1; 22.4; 21.2; 19.12 Deɛ ɔdi nkonim no, mɛyɛ no fadum me Nyankopɔn asɔredan mu, na ɔremfiri adi bio, na mɛtwerɛ me Nyankopɔn din wɔ ne so, ne me Nyankopɔn kuro a ɛyɛ Yerusalem foforɔ, a ɛfiri soro ba fam firi me Nyankopɔn nkyɛn no din, ne me din foforɔ no. 13Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no ka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no.
Laodikea nwoma
14 # Adi 1.5; Yoh 1.3; Kol 1.15 Na Laodikea asafo mu bɔfoɔ no, twerɛ kɔma no sɛ: Sɛɛ na Amen, ɔdanseni a ɔsɛ sɛ wɔgye no die na ɔyɛ ɔnokwafoɔ no, Nyankopɔn abɔdeɛ farebae no seɛ: 15#Adi 2.2 Menim wo nnwuma sɛ wonyɛ nwunu na wonyɛ hyeɛ. Sɛ woyɛ nwunu anaa woyɛ hye a, anka ɛyɛ. 16Na afei deɛ, ɛnam sɛ woyɛ boturobodwo na wonyɛ hyeɛ anaa nwunu nti, mɛfe wo mafiri m’anomu. 17#1 Ko 3.18; 4.8 Ɛfiri sɛ wose: Meyɛ ɔdefoɔ na manya me ho, na hwee nhia me, na wonnim sɛ wo ara ne ɔmanehunufoɔ ne mmɔborɔni ne ohiani ne onifirani ne ɔdagyani. 18#Yes 55.1; 1 Pe 1.7; Adi 16.15 Metu wo fo sɛ, tɔ me nkyɛn sika a wɔabere ho ogya mu, na woanya ahonya ne atadeɛ fitaa, na woahyɛ, na w’adagya ahohora anna adi, ne aniduro a wode bɛsra w’ani, na woahunu adeɛ. 19#Mmb 3.12; 1 Ko 11.32; Heb 12.6 Dodoɔ a medɔ wɔn no, meyi wɔn atɛn, na metwe wɔn aso. Enti bɔ mmɔden na sakyera w’adwene!
20 # Luka 12.36; Yoh 14.23 Hwɛ, megyina ɛpono ano na mebɔ mu. Sɛ obi bɛtie me nne na wahini ɛpono no a, mɛhyɛne mu maba ne nkyɛn, na me ne no abɛdidi, na ɔne me nso adidi. 21#Mat 19.28 Deɛ ɔdi nkonim no, mɛma ɔne me atena m’ahennwa so, sɛdeɛ me nso madi nkonim na me ne m’Agya te n’ahennwa soɔ no. 22Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no ka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no.

Na Sardi asafo mu bɔfoɔ no, twerɛ kɔma no sɛ: Sɛɛ na deɛ ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn ahonhom nson ne nsoromma nson no seɛ: Menim wo nnwuma, sɛ wowɔ din sɛ wote aseɛ, nanso woawuo. Nyane, na hyɛ nkaeɛ a ɛrebɛwuo no den. Na menhunuu wo nnwuma sɛ ɛyɛ pɛ me Nyankopɔn anim. Enti kae sɛdeɛ woanya na woateɛ na di so, na sakyera w’adwene! Na sɛ woanwɛn a, mɛba sɛ owifoɔ, na worenhunu dɔn ko a mɛba wo soɔ. Nanso wowɔ nnipa kakraa bi a wɔnguu wɔn ntadeɛ ho fi wɔ Sardi, na wɔne me bɛnante ntadeɛ fitaa mu, ɛfiri sɛ wɔfata. Deɛ ɔdi nkonim no na wɔbɛhyɛ no atadeɛ fitaa saa, na merempepa ne din mfiri nkwa nwoma no mu, na mɛbɔ ne din m’Agya ne n’abɔfoɔ anim. Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no reka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no.

Na Filadelfia asafo mu bɔfoɔ no, twerɛ kɔma no sɛ:
Sɛɛ na ɔkronkronni, ɔnokwafoɔ no,
deɛ ɔkura Dawid safoa,
na ɔhini a obi nto mu,
na ɔto mu, a obi nhini no, seɛ:
Menim wo nnwuma. Hwɛ, mede ɛpono a wɔahini masi w’anim a obi ntumi nto mu, ɛfiri sɛ wowɔ ahoɔden ketewa bi, na woadi m’asɛm so, na woampa me din. Hwɛ, mede ebinom a wɔfiri Satan hyiadan mu, a wɔka sɛ wɔyɛ Yudafoɔ, na wɔnyɛ, na mmom wɔdi atorɔ no mema. Hwɛ, mɛma wɔaba na wɔabɛkoto wo nan ase, na wɔahunu sɛ madɔ wo. Ɛsiane sɛ woadi me boasetɔ asɛm soɔ nti, me nso mɛkora wo, sɔhwɛ berɛ a ɛbɛba wiase nyinaa soɔ, sɛ wɔbɛsɔ wɔn a wɔte asase soɔ ahwɛ no, mu. Mereba ntɛm; sɔ deɛ wowɔ no mu, na obi annye w’abotire.
Deɛ ɔdi nkonim no, mɛyɛ no fadum me Nyankopɔn asɔredan mu, na ɔremfiri adi bio, na mɛtwerɛ me Nyankopɔn din wɔ ne so, ne me Nyankopɔn kuro a ɛyɛ Yerusalem foforɔ, a ɛfiri soro ba fam firi me Nyankopɔn nkyɛn no din, ne me din foforɔ no. Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no ka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no.

Na Laodikea asafo mu bɔfoɔ no, twerɛ kɔma no sɛ: Sɛɛ na Amen, ɔdanseni a ɔsɛ sɛ wɔgye no die na ɔyɛ ɔnokwafoɔ no, Nyankopɔn abɔdeɛ farebae no seɛ: Menim wo nnwuma sɛ wonyɛ nwunu na wonyɛ hyeɛ. Sɛ woyɛ nwunu anaa woyɛ hye a, anka ɛyɛ. Na afei deɛ, ɛnam sɛ woyɛ boturobodwo na wonyɛ hyeɛ anaa nwunu nti, mɛfe wo mafiri m’anomu. Ɛfiri sɛ wose: Meyɛ ɔdefoɔ na manya me ho, na hwee nhia me, na wonnim sɛ wo ara ne ɔmanehunufoɔ ne mmɔborɔni ne ohiani ne onifirani ne ɔdagyani. Metu wo fo sɛ, tɔ me nkyɛn sika a wɔabere ho ogya mu, na woanya ahonya ne atadeɛ fitaa, na woahyɛ, na w’adagya ahohora anna adi, ne aniduro a wode bɛsra w’ani, na woahunu adeɛ. Dodoɔ a medɔ wɔn no, meyi wɔn atɛn, na metwe wɔn aso. Enti bɔ mmɔden na sakyera w’adwene!
Hwɛ, megyina ɛpono ano na mebɔ mu. Sɛ obi bɛtie me nne na wahini ɛpono no a, mɛhyɛne mu maba ne nkyɛn, na me ne no abɛdidi, na ɔne me nso adidi. Deɛ ɔdi nkonim no, mɛma ɔne me atena m’ahennwa so, sɛdeɛ me nso madi nkonim na me ne m’Agya te n’ahennwa soɔ no. Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no ka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
